name: gmod
description: Planned work with proof in Codex: claim a job, stay in its files, fail first, then pass, then commit. Runs the gmod CLI from PATH (npm link in a gmod checkout, or the released CLI).

interface.shortDescription: Planned work with proof: claim, red, green, commit
interface.longDescription: gmod holds Codex agents to a plan the person approved: each job names the files it may change and the checks that prove it done. Hooks refuse edits outside the claimed job and commits before a check failed and then passed; the MCP tools claim, check, commit and draft plan changes. The person decides plans and ADRs in a terminal of their own with gmod watch or gmod decide. Needs the gmod CLI on PATH.
defaultPrompt: Take the next ready gmod job and finish it with proof
